long_biography.plain_text:
Fiducial was built around a precise operating idea: give smaller businesses access to the range of professional services normally available to larger companies. Christian Latouche applied the organization he had encountered at major audit firms, pairing specialized expertise with a distributed office network close to clients.

That model developed through acquisitions and specialist divisions. Finance, technology, security, real estate and office products joined the original accounting base, allowing clients to use one group for recurring business needs. Latouche remains Fiducial's chairman, while France's audit regulator also records him as chairman of Fidaudit and Sarex.
